paper.title_en: Nonlinear pole topology of slow currents in holographic probe-brane metals
paper.abstract_en: Low-frequency Drude response does not by itself determine which nearly conserved sector carries an electric current. We classify the leading cubic retarded response of an isolated, inversion-symmetric slow vector by its pole topology. Constitutive nonlinearity produces only incoming-frequency poles, whereas nonlinear relaxation adds a propagator at the emitted frequency; coupling to a second scalar slow mode generates pair-frequency poles. We then compute the full complex third-harmonic response of finite-density Dirac--Born--Infeld probe branes in Lifshitz black-brane backgrounds. In the marginal $z=2$ theory, the dense infrared response approaches the relaxation topology, with a signed infrared weight $p_{\rm IR}=0.994\pm0.002$ and a normalization-independent zero at $ω_\times/Γ_J=0.2918$. Nonmarginal $z=1$ and $z=3/2$ backgrounds instead realize mixed constitutive--relaxation weights, demonstrating that the topology is selected dynamically rather than imposed by the DBI square root. The exact nonlinear dc solution further yields a parameter-free dense-limit scaling function and a crossover field $E_{\rm nl}\propto T^{3/2}$ at $z=2$. These results connect emergent higher-form slow currents, nonlinear response theory, and holographic transport, while the two-mode extension identifies the additional pole structures expected when energy or deformation modes remain slow.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文分类了慢矢量的立方推迟响应，并在Lifshitz黑膜背景下计算了DBI探针膜的三次谐波响应，连接了全息输运、高阶形式慢流和非线性响应理论，理论深度和创新性较高，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 全息探针膜金属中慢电流的非线性极点拓扑
decision.abstract_zh: 低频Drude响应本身并不能确定哪个近守恒扇区携带电流。我们按极点拓扑对孤立、反演对称慢矢量的主导立方推迟响应进行分类。本构非线性仅产生入射频率极点，而非线性弛豫则在发射频率处添加一个传播子；与第二个标量慢模的耦合产生对频率极点。然后我们计算有限密度Dirac--Born--Infeld探针膜在Lifshitz黑膜背景中的完整复三次谐波响应。在边缘$z=2$理论中，稠密红外响应趋近弛豫拓扑，具有带符号的红外权重$p_{\rm IR}=0.994\pm0.002$和一个与归一化无关的零点在$ω_\times/Γ_J=0.2918$处。非边缘的$z=1$和$z=3/2$背景则实现混合的本构--弛豫权重，表明拓扑是动态选择的，而不是由DBI平方根强加的。精确的非线性直流解进一步给出无参数的稠密极限标度函数和在$z=2$处的交叉场$E_{\rm nl}\propto T^{3/2}$。这些结果将涌现高阶形式慢电流、非线性响应理论和全息输运联系起来，而双模扩展确定了当能量或形变模式保持慢速时所预期的额外极点结构。
